verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the homepage claim of "customized summaries" after every meeting, which suggests the summary format can be shaped. Nothing documents templates, saved prompts, or per-meeting-type selection (discovery call, 1:1, standup). AskFred's ad-hoc Q&A is an adjacent feature and is not credited. missing for 10: documented custom note templates or saved prompts, assignment by meeting type, any detail on how customization works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
